objective: Build our own complete Highfield creative platform from the existing open-higgsfield fork.
status_meaning: All listed modules are in scope. State describes current coverage, not completion or a promise that proprietary engines are self-hosted.
source_policy: Preserve licensed upstream source and provenance. Keep native upstream APIs optional; independently implement workflows and prompts that are unavailable as licensed source.
completion_rule: A module is complete only when its UI, app service, authorization, compatible engine, durable outputs and acceptance checks are verified.

delivery_phases.name: Shared platform foundations
delivery_phases.gate: Account/workspace isolation, ownership migration, projects, provider services and durable jobs before enabling multiple users.

delivery_phases.name: Creation and workflow foundation
delivery_phases.gate: Original prompt/skill runtime, full creation studios, our Cinema/Director workflow, audio/editor/export and authenticated MCP.

delivery_phases.name: Advanced studios and administration
delivery_phases.gate: Genjutsu-style editing, Katana, Canvas, marketing/Ads, identities/avatars, 3D, localization and auditable usage.

delivery_phases.name: Extended platform and integrations
delivery_phases.gate: Specialized studios, creative-app bridges, reference capture, code projects, sharing and learning content.

modules.title: Complete interface and button behavior
deliverables: Navigation and every studio screen, dialog, menu, picker and account control
Desktop/mobile layouts, keyboard access, themes and localization
Control inventory mapping each button to its action, permission, service and state
acceptance: Each visible control performs its documented action or explains a specific unavailable dependency
Test loading, empty, validation, success, failure and cancellation states
Check desktop and narrow mobile layouts; preserve navigation and saved state after refresh

modules.title: Accounts, authentication and sessions
current_evidence: src/proxy.ts currently handles locale only; authentication is external shared-owner ingress
deliverables: Owner bootstrap, login/logout, profile, password changes and recovery
Session expiry/revocation, sign-in protection and optional federated identity/MFA
Account disable/delete with ownership transfer and data export rules
Configured email verification and Google/Apple/Microsoft identity adapters with verified redirect and recovery flows
acceptance: Server authorizes every API and protected asset request
Password/recovery/session secrets never appear in logs, normal reads or the public repository
Disabling an account or revoking a session immediately removes access

modules.title: Teams, workspaces and permissions
current_evidence: src/types/index.ts and src/lib/task-store.ts have no workspace/actor ownership
deliverables: Workspace creation/switching, invitations and membership
Owner/admin/member/viewer permissions; separate private and shared projects
Workspace-scoped provider credentials, projects, jobs, assets, prompts and audit events
Organization groups, bulk member import/export and optional enterprise SSO/SAML with real provider setup
acceptance: Two workspaces cannot read, mutate, stream or download each other's records using guessed IDs
Background polling and MCP use the submitting workspace's credentials
Member changes and invite expiry/revocation are enforced server-side

modules.title: Administration and account management
deliverables: User, role, invitation, workspace and provider administration
Audit trail, operational settings and usage overview
Quota, retention, account recovery and ownership management
acceptance: Role restrictions apply to UI and direct API/MCP calls
Prevent removal of the final owner and record sensitive changes without secrets
Admin lists and searches are scoped and paginated

modules.title: Models, providers and integration settings
deliverables: Preserve existing model catalog and discover all supported provider capabilities
Separate planning, vision, image, video, audio, 3D and editing capabilities
Workspace connections, key rotation, health checks and explicit local/cloud routing
acceptance: Expose only parameters and media roles the selected endpoint accepts
Installed, loaded, configured and inference-verified are separate states
No silent cloud fallback or credentials in browser model payloads

modules.title: Generation jobs, queue, cost and recovery
deliverables: Durable workflow/job IDs, dependencies, revisions and worker queues
Quotes, cost limits, progress, cancel, explicit retry and reconciliation
Bounded concurrency, local-worker resource limits and output persistence
acceptance: Accepted provider IDs survive restart without duplicate submission
Uncertain submissions are reconciled before retry; cancellation reaches workers/providers when supported
Workspace isolation covers status/events/downloads and usage accounting

modules.title: Projects and asset library
deliverables: Projects/folders, uploads, thumbnails, favorites, references and search
Versioned assets and provenance linking inputs, prompts, skills, models and outputs
Download/export, deletion, retention and explicit public/private sharing
acceptance: Every asset belongs to a workspace and has authorized access
Reusing media does not require an unrelated cloud upload service for local workflows
Restart and export preserve project references and editable metadata

modules.title: Prompt library and prompt engineering
current_evidence: Licensed prompt/procedure source in third_party/higgsfield-skills; no in-app prompt library yet
deliverables: Editable templates with variables, tags, languages and model compatibility
Versioning, favorites, import/export and project-local variations
Licensed source attribution and generated-prompt history
acceptance: Missing variables and unsupported inputs are validated before submission
Each job pins the exact prompt/template revision
Publicly sourced prompts retain provenance; private prompt text is not claimed to be recovered

modules.title: Skills, recipes and workflow runtime
deliverables: Pinned licensed upstream skill sources and independently authored Highfield workflows
Manifest with inputs, steps, tools, compatible engines, outputs and version
Skill browser, editing/import/export, run history and dependency preflight
acceptance: Imported upstream files are not automatically executable or native-compatible
Tools and script execution are constrained to declared workspace permissions and worker boundaries
A skill is runnable only when all required steps and engines are connected

modules.title: Effects and preset catalog
deliverables: Searchable/versioned image, video, motion, marketing and style presets
Licensed or original previews and explicit reference slots
Parameter forms, variants, batch runs and compatible-engine selection
acceptance: Displayed presets map to executable recipes or an explicit missing dependency
Recipe, source and preview licenses are recorded separately
Each successful preset run yields a saved result and reproducible inputs

modules.title: Image Studio, image editing and upscaling
deliverables: Text/image/reference generation, variations and batch comparison
Image editing, masks/inpainting, outpainting and upscaling through compatible engines
Model-aware aspect ratio, resolution, seed, style and reference controls
acceptance: Round-trip real images through generation, history, reuse, preview and download
Unsupported edit/vector workflows remain explicit until implemented
Verify mask geometry, source references and output dimensions for editing workflows

modules.title: Video Studio and reference conditioning
deliverables: Text/image/video/audio reference workflows, start/end frames and variations
Native audio, duration/resolution/aspect ratio and camera controls where supported
Source-video editing/upscaling and batch output comparison
acceptance: Validate source duration, dimensions, reference limits and endpoint capabilities before submission
Generated videos play and seek correctly after persistence and restart
Output history retains the exact selected model, inputs and controls

modules.title: Cinema Studio and cinematic projects
current_evidence: src/models/capabilities/highfield.ts contains optional native Cinema API adapter
deliverables: Our project/scene/shot model, editable storyboard and multi-shot continuity
Camera/lens/movement references, elements, variants and selected takes
Narration/audio placement, assembled timeline and export
Project and shot overrides for camera/lens/focal/aperture, era/tempo/genre, lighting/palette, references, extensions and regional edits
acceptance: A saved project can be planned, edited, generated, reopened and exported
Camera guidance is distinguished from physically enforced renderer controls
Our workflow can use compatible non-Higgsfield engines; the native endpoint remains optional

modules.title: Genjutsu-style motion transfer
deliverables: Source-video/reference workflow and independent compatible-engine adapter
Motion guidance, subject/scene replacement and per-output comparison
Native optional Higgsfield endpoint plus original alternative workflow
acceptance: Measure motion/temporal continuity on actual outputs; UI similarity does not establish equivalence
Validate all required reference and source constraints
Store source, recipe, engine, parameters and final media for each run

modules.title: Genjutsu-style object and subject replacement
deliverables: Select source, target region/subject and replacement references
Compatible editing adapter with mask/reference translation
Variants and comparisons of edited versus preserved regions
acceptance: A real output changes the intended target and evaluates preservation of untargeted content
Unsupported localization/masking is never silently ignored
Native provider execution and our independently implemented replacement workflow are separately identified

modules.title: Genjutsu-style restyling and transformations
deliverables: Style/reference transformations and recipe-driven versions
Temporal consistency controls and batch independent edits
Compatible native/local/cloud adapters after schema verification
acceptance: Verify the actual executable endpoint before advertising a runnable engine
Each variant is independently tracked with its cost and provenance
Preservation and style quality are evaluated on a real clip

modules.title: Katana-style reference-edit recreation
deliverables: Reference-video scene/cut/keyframe analysis
Editable shot matching, product/character replacements and timing
Per-shot regeneration, revision history and final assembly
acceptance: A reference edit produces a reviewed shot plan with real source timings
Replacement scenes are generated and assembled in the intended order
Iterative edits update selected shots without claiming the hosted Katana service was copied

modules.title: Marketing Studio and Ads Studio
deliverables: Brand kits, products, media, avatars, hooks, formats and reusable settings
Image/video ad briefs, quotes, generation runs and campaign variants
Comparison, history, placement export and product consistency
acceptance: Brand/product CRUD and generated assets stay in the selected workspace
Quotes and run states reflect the actual selected providers
A complete ad run produces usable media in the requested placement

modules.title: Ad Multiplier and batch targeted edits
deliverables: Source ad plus independent product/subject/background/text variants
Per-variant instructions, immutable source and preserved untargeted material
Batch queue, previews, revision and export
acceptance: Each requested independent edit gets its own durable job/output
Compare timing, motion, audio and untargeted text with the source
No unsupported Cartesian or preservation guarantee is implied

modules.title: AI Influencer, identities and reusable elements
deliverables: Reusable character/environment/prop references and character sheets
Influencer setups, looks, outfits, scenes and output variants
Optional custom identity/LoRA engines and identity asset management
acceptance: An identity can be reused across supported jobs with explicit compatible conditioning
Training, reference reuse and native proprietary identity services remain distinct capabilities
Private reference/training data is scoped, exportable and removable

modules.title: Voicebox audio, speech and voice workflows
current_evidence: HIGHFIELD_AUDIO_URL links the separate Voicebox studio; local Kokoro synthesis verified
deliverables: Workspace-scoped Voicebox voice/profile and narration asset integration
Speech, cloning, transcription, dubbing and effects for installed engines
Music/SFX and native video audio through compatible additional engines
acceptance: Record actual installed/loaded engine availability; download is not inference verification
Generated narration becomes a versioned project asset with measured duration
Identity, audio access and job ownership are preserved across the Highfield/Voicebox boundary

modules.title: Avatars, presenters and lip synchronization
deliverables: Presenter/reference inputs, speech selection and lip-sync engine routing
UGC tutorial, review, unboxing, try-on and website/product workflows
Timed host overlays and shot-specific narration
acceptance: Verify actual speech/lip timing and subject continuity
Input and duration restrictions follow the selected engine
Each workflow exports a real playable video rather than only a script or still

modules.title: Captions, translation and localization
deliverables: Transcription, editable timed text and speaker metadata
Subtitle export and burned captions with font/style/layout controls
Translated narration, dubbed variants and localized ads
acceptance: Caption time bounds and synchronization are measured against media
Distinguish subtitle files, soft tracks and burned pixels
Every locale/version retains its source and revision provenance

modules.title: Video editor, motion graphics and export
deliverables: Timeline for cuts, trim/speed, transitions, text and overlays
Audio mixing, captions, graphic tracks and reusable compositions
Isolated FFmpeg/render worker, previews and final exports
acceptance: Timeline revisions produce deterministic measured timing and playable output
Render work is bounded, cancellable and recoverable after failure
Exports preserve dimensions, frame rate, audio and selected composition settings

modules.title: Canvas boards and executable workflows
deliverables: Typed nodes, edges, media/prompt/control inputs and board revision storage
DAG validation, node preflight, quote, run/cancel and rerun
Node results/history and incremental project reuse
acceptance: Reject cycles, missing dependencies, stale revisions and cross-workspace references
Rerunning a changed node invalidates only the affected downstream results
Board execution persists accepted jobs and outputs across restart

modules.title: 3D Jutsu-style scene creation
deliverables: Project scenes, asset search/import and interactive previews
Guarded Blender operations with scene revisions and camera/light controls
GLB/blend exports, renders and image/video generation from scenes
Editable hierarchy/primitives/transforms, lights, cameras, animation trajectories/timeline, undo/redo and revision restore
acceptance: Only settled authorized scene revisions become downloadable artifacts
Conflicting edits are rejected and long worker jobs support cancel/status
A real scene can be reopened, edited, rendered and exported

modules.title: Director agent and creative orchestration
deliverables: Persisted conversations, structured/editable plans and project context
Scoped model/provider tools and skill execution with budgets
Real media analysis, iterations, cancellation and resumable runs
User/workspace-visible skills, persistent memory, connectors and apps with explicit permissions
Ask/planning versus generation/execution modes with measured cost and visible run state
acceptance: Text/vision reasoning never masquerades as media synthesis
Tool calls respect workspace roles, explicit engine selection and output schemas
A plan can drive controlled jobs and retain their results/provenance

modules.title: Highfield MCP server and agent integrations
current_evidence: src/app/api/mcp/route.ts currently exposes four read-only tools
deliverables: Authenticated tools/resources/prompts backed by the same app services
Discover/quote/upload/submit/status/cancel/assets/projects/skills/usage tools
Workspace-scoped tokens, clients/CLI configuration and documented errors
acceptance: UI, REST and MCP enforce the same permissions and job semantics
A real MCP client can initialize, discover and complete an implemented workflow
Unimplemented services are not advertised as functioning tools; credentials are never returned

modules.title: Public API, SDK, service tokens and webhooks
deliverables: Versioned schemas, API credentials/scopes and documented SDK/CLI contracts
Idempotency/reconciliation, pagination, uploads and signed callbacks
Developer settings, token rotation and callback delivery history
acceptance: Service tokens cannot cross workspace or permission boundaries
Event/callback retries do not create duplicate generation jobs
Examples use documented executable endpoints and contain no owner secrets

modules.title: Usage, budgets, credits and billing administration
deliverables: Provider quotes/cost records, usage charts and per-workspace/member budgets
Auditable credit reservations, settlement, failed-job release and limits
Optional subscriptions/payments/invoices with test-mode provider integration
Explicit product policies for gifts/promocodes, refill, spending pauses, invoices and failed-job reconciliation if enabled
acceptance: Credits and prices reflect real provider/product rules and an auditable ledger
Unknown estimates are explicit; uncertain jobs do not silently double-charge
No live payment, recurring billing or real purchase is created by setup/tests

modules.title: Community, collaboration and publishing
deliverables: Private/public project links, favorites, remixable provenance and discovery
Profile pages, shared galleries and collaborative review
Explicit publish/unpublish, retention and moderation controls
Revision-linked comments, chat, reactions, approvals and optional real-time calls with separately verified media infrastructure
acceptance: Outputs remain private until an authorized user publishes them
Revocation and workspace membership changes remove protected access
A public/shared view never exposes private keys or unrelated assets

modules.title: Website/game builder and hosted code projects
deliverables: Isolated code projects, editable previews, build/deploy/status and source export
Project databases, managed secret names and revision-based deployment
Optional community publishing and external hosting adapters
acceptance: Build/deploy is isolated from the host and other workspaces
Secret values remain outside source exports, previews and MCP readback
Actual hosting/deployment contracts are verified before a provider is enabled

modules.title: Creative-app integrations and production skills
deliverables: Licensed/public skill sources and our compatible tool adapters
Blender/FFmpeg workflows plus optional After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, Resolve and TouchDesigner bridges
Detect app availability, runtime dependencies and editable output formats
acceptance: Source code license and required commercial app licenses are recorded separately
An upstream skill is not claimed to work without its required app/tools
Produce and reopen the declared editable artifact for each integrated workflow

modules.title: Local workers, deployment and operations
current_evidence: Single-owner deployment and local model connections exist
deliverables: Scoped local image/video/audio/3D workers with engine/version discovery
Queues, resource/concurrency limits, cancellation, health and diagnostics
Backup/restore, migration/rollback and secret-safe monitoring
acceptance: Preserve current owner data, working providers and application access during migration
Local workers cannot read unrelated host/workspace files or silently switch to cloud
Verify recovery with a real job and restore test before claiming operation readiness

modules.title: Specialized creative studios
deliverables: Photodump/product/photo shoots, fashion/try-on, storyboard/Popcorn and mixed-media workflows
Reusable input forms, recipes, previews and editable project variants
Supported-model filtering and explicit per-studio engine requirements
acceptance: Each advertised studio has a concrete input-to-output workflow and retained project state
Result quality, continuity and export are evaluated with representative real inputs
Marketing labels alone do not mark a workflow implemented

modules.title: Reference collection and browser integration
deliverables: Reference capture/import with source/provenance and project destination
Optional browser extension/client integration with scoped authorization
Reference-element editing, search and reuse
acceptance: Imported references preserve attribution and selected workspace
Browser client has only the permissions needed for explicit capture
Captured source/media uses a documented authenticated import path

modules.title: Prompt guides, help and learning content
deliverables: Original/licensed prompt guides, workflow documentation and examples
Searchable help/academy resources linked to actual features
Optional showcases, challenges and community discovery
acceptance: Examples are marked as demonstrations with their actual dependencies
Source content and media licensing is recorded before redistribution
Guides and in-product help match the current implementation

modules.title: Image Layers editor and compositions
deliverables: Editable image layers, masks, transforms, ordering, blend/composite controls and undo/redo
Project revisions, image generation/editing integration and layered composition persistence
Flattened exports and compatible editable interchange formats
Layer decomposition, text detection/replacement, background removal, relighting, expand/crop, grading and angle tools with verified adapters
acceptance: Reopen an image composition with its layers, masks and references intact
Layer edits and generation affect only the intended regions and preserve revision history
Image Layers and the video/motion editor have distinct documented formats and controls

multiuser_release_gate.current_mode: Single shared owner studio with external ingress authentication; application multiuser accounts are not implemented.
migration_requirements: Assign current owner history, assets and credentials to an explicit owner workspace using a repeatable migration.
Replace process-global credential selection with a job-bound connection context.
Require authorized workspace context in repositories, every REST/MCP operation, streams and media requests.
Persist submission intent and idempotency before externally charged operations; reconcile uncertain outcomes.
Add transactional persistence, worker leases and workspace-aware cache invalidation.
Verify owner recovery and restore before changing ingress or allowing new accounts.
isolation_tests: Cross-workspace reads, writes, uploads, reuse, SSE, Range downloads and MCP.
Concurrent generation and polling with different credential fixtures.
Owner/admin/member/viewer permissions, role changes, session revocation, invite expiry and last-owner protection.
Workspace switching clears caches, references and unauthorized pending results.
Migration repeatability, empty-store behavior, rollback and backup restore.
